title: RICE SERVED IN ITALIAN STYLE WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
instructions: --Steam or boil one-half pound of rice until done, then drain. Remove meat from mushroom sauce. Drop rice into mushroom sauce and cook about five minutes. Pour on platter and sprinkle heavy with grated cheese.
